headline: Why ‘Heated Rivalry’ Received No Emmy Nominations While Connor Storrie Did
context: Even if voters had wanted to honor the gay hockey drama, which became a hit on HBO Max, they couldn’t have. But the Emmys did recognize one of the stars.
